title: S3Gym: Can LLMs Turn Self-Testing and Self-Judging into Self-Improvement?
abstract: arXiv:2608.31100v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly interact with external environments and accumulate substantial behavioral experience, yet existing agent benchmarks largely evaluate them as fixed policies. It therefore remains unclear whether an agent can actively test its behavior, judge the resulting experience, and use that experience to improve future decisions. We introduce \textbf{S\textsuperscript{3}Gym}, an interactive benchmark for evaluating LLM self-improvement through three coupled capabilities: \textbf{Self-Testing}, \textbf{Self-Judging}, and \textbf{Self-Improvement}. S$^3$Gym separates permissive exploration from strict held-out evaluation and instantiates this protocol in seven text-based games with executable environment verifiers. translated_title: S³Gym：大语言模型能否将自我测试与自我评判转化为自我提升？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.31100v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地与外部环境交互并积累大量的行为经验，然而现有的智能体基准测试大多将它们视为固定策略进行评估。因此，目前尚不清楚智能体能否主动测试自身行为、评判由此产生的经验，并利用这些经验来改进未来的决策。我们提出了S³Gym，这是一个用于评估大语言模型自我提升能力的交互式基准，围绕三种相互耦合的能力展开：自我测试、自我评判和自我提升。S³Gym将宽松的探索与严格的保留集评估分离开来，并在七个配备可执行环境验证器的文本游戏中实现了这一协议。我们评估了三种融入交互经验的途径：直接的历史情境学习、基于分数条件化的摘要记忆，以及参数训练。我们的实验表明，自我提升是……
tldr: 该论文提出S³Gym交互式基准，通过自我测试、自我评判和自我提升三种耦合能力评估大语言模型的自我提升，并在七个文本游戏中比较了历史ICL、摘要记忆和参数训练三种经验融入途径的效果。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces S³Gym, an interactive benchmark evaluating LLM self-improvement through three coupled capabilities—Self-Testing, Self-Judging, and Self-Improvement—implemented in seven text-based games, and compares three experience-incorporation pathways: direct History ICL, score-conditioned Summary Memory, and parameter Training.
